evidence.scope: Uncalibrated single-fibril heating, viscocapillary time scale, wet bending and factory mass-cost balances. No grain manufacture, CFD, sintering or ski validation.

thermal.note: Scenario constants, not an identified HDPE grade. Cylinders, spatially uniform temperature, no conduction to connected branches, uniform gas history. Viscocapillary time eta*r/gamma is only a scaling time, not a proven rounding or breakup duration.

wet.note: Two identical cantilevers, transverse end force F=2*pi*r*gamma*b. Force factor b is hypothetical, not an inferred contact angle. No real bridge geometry, adhesion, creep, nonlinear buckling or entanglement.

factory.note: Hypothetical pretax comparison, no quote. Closed factory, hydrocarbon route only; S4 CFC-11 procedure is excluded. Recovery shortfall means makeup plus controlled waste/residual balance, not allowable environmental release. Reject feed is not credited as saleable or indefinitely recyclable. New finishing/QC cost not established.
